Proposed diagram changes
  |-- Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw)  existing canvas
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: MappingPage                              baseline 03f2168, before tldraw
  |   |   `-- Reorganize live ownership: MappingEditorCanvas mounts MappingEditorRuntime; the editor owns live geometry and undo, while MappingDocumentController supplies semantic commands and checkpoint archival. Preserve CanvasWorkspace, CanvasSession and persistence ownership. Expose CanvasRuntime and its transient geometry stores before expanding them.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [A] GridBox / LineGridScene
  |   |   `-- Add the domain-layout boundary: cells project into editor pixels; settled native movement returns rounded absolute cell positions, then runs domain layout. Retain containment, parent-relative storage and push-right layout.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [C] FloatingBox variants
  |   |   `-- Extend DisplayNodeBase geometry with native projection and settled position/size writeback. Movement sets manual placement; resizing sets fixed sizing. Preserve automatic placement and pane ownership; distinguish native shapes from application-only panels.
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: [D] Controller edits / agent access
  |   |   `-- Reorganize around gesture settlement, staged semantic operations and checkpoint publication. Show editor-driven live undo versus headless history navigation, stored revision commands, default buffered exec and optional immediate mode. Preserve validation, node correspondence and live/proposal routing.
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: [E] CanvasHistoryService / coordinated revisions
  |   |   `-- Separate the semantic checkpoint archive from live editor undo. Replace append-time content revision allocation with binding already issued, retained revisions. Keep context navigation, forks and persistence responsibilities.
  |   |-- [2] Add: MappingEditorRuntime - projection, settlement and undo
  |   |   `-- Attach from MappingPage's MappingEditorRuntime component. Detail checkpoint-reference hydration, projectMappingShapes, deferred projection during pointing, idle settlement, one gesture checkpoint and native undo restoration. Explain that commands settle pending gestures before version checks; camera and pointer-move frames do not write controller state.
  |   `-- [2] Add: CanvasRuntime - transient geometry and routing
  |       `-- Attach from MappingPage's CanvasRuntime component. Develop the existing canvas-runtime subject: reactive per-object read models, LocalAnchorStore measurements and NativeRoutingStore routes follow editor transforms without becoming persisted geometry. Keep this separate from checkpoint synchronization detail.
  |-- Unified selection - state, gestures and WebSocket  existing canvas
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: CanvasSession
  |   |   `-- Replace mutual exclusion and the old input model with application membership alongside native drag handles. Whole-diagram and region items can coexist; regions retain explicit contentNodeIds, captured ASCII and sourceRevisionId, while rectangles are presentation envelopes. Preserve separate focus, panel and transport responsibilities. Show chat's captured content/revision context separately from native selection and active-turn canvas targeting.
  |   `-- [2] Add: SelectionGestureController and NativeSelectionOwnership
  |       `-- Attach from explicit components in the redrawn CanvasSession overview. Detail transient preview, completion and cancellation, mouse/pen/touch recognition, multi-contact blocking and ownership retained across delayed native events. Connect SelectionToolBridge to the editor; native selection enables dragging rather than replacing semantic membership. Avoid duplicating geometry writeback.
  |-- Mapping page - MCP and HTTP API  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: Mapping page: exposed interfaces at 03f2168
  |   |   `-- Replace exec's unconditional per-mutation commit description with default batched execution and optional immediate mode. Preserve the interface-inventory organization.
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: Mapping backend: grouped responsibilities (03f2168)
  |   |   `-- Correct Direct operations and Mutation contract: queued handles precede application, flushes return compact receipts, and atomicity applies per flushed batch rather than per script. Preserve CanvasSessionBridge versus ChangeSessionService routing.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: Mapping backend: grouped responsibilities (03f2168)
  |   |   `-- Expose exec buffering and ChatCanvasBindings under AgentDiagrammingSessionService. Show capture of the active turn's target before awaiting attachment, binding checks and read-only enforcement. Target binding is distinct from captured selection content and revision references.
  |   `-- [2] Add: AgentDiagrammingSessionService.exec - buffering and flush boundaries
  |       `-- Attach from the overview's exec buffering component. Detail flushing before canvas calls, reads, setSourceMappings and setJumps, and after successful script completion. Queued IDs support dependent writes; receipts describe final batch state. Preserve batch IDs and expected versions for uncertain retries. Unflushed work is not committed after an uncaught failure; earlier flushed batches remain. Contrast immediate mode without duplicating the bridge architecture.
  |-- ChangeSession - domain model and call tree  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: [CALLS] ChangeSession operations
  |   |   `-- Replace immediate application of every nodes/edges mutation with one ChangeSessionService.apply per default exec flush; retain immediate mode as an option. Preserve session serialization, receipts and persistence.
  |   `-- [1b] Extend: [H] Isolated history and undo/redo
  |       `-- Make the headless boundary explicit at ChangeSessionService.controller(): without an attached editor driver, MappingDocumentController navigates domain history. This extends the existing isolated-history explanation rather than replacing it.
  |-- Workspace persistence flow  existing canvas
  |   `-- [1b] Extend: Workspace persistence flow - baseline 03f2168
  |       `-- Add MappingEditorRuntime settlement upstream of CanvasSession's committed-history notification. Semantic commands and settled gestures publish checkpoints; camera and pointer-move frames do not. Preserve the downstream persistence pipeline and link runtime detail from this explicit producer.
  |-- Roll-up 1 / g2 / Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw) (C12)  existing canvas
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: MappingPage                              baseline 03f2168, before tldraw
  |   |   `-- Correct the duplicated ownership overview around MappingEditorCanvas, MappingEditorRuntime, CanvasRuntime and MappingDocumentController. Preserve workspace, persistence, revision, alternatives and review attachments. Connect explicit runtime components to canonical detail on Canvas domain model rather than copying it.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [A] GridBox / LineGridScene
  |   |   `-- Add domain-cell/editor-pixel projection and settled movement boundaries; retain containment and domain layout.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [C] FloatingBox variants
  |   |   `-- Extend DisplayNodeBase with native projection and settled geometry writeback; preserve variant and placement responsibilities.
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: [D] Controller edits / agent access
  |   |   `-- Replace the per-call flow with settlement, semantic batches, live editor undo and headless fallback. Preserve the review-application attachment. Link AgentDiagrammingSessionService.exec to its buffering detail on Mapping page - MCP and HTTP API.
  |   `-- [1a] Correct: [E] CanvasHistoryService / coordinated revisions
  |       `-- Separate checkpoint archival from native undo and replace append-time revision allocation with binding issued revisions. Preserve the checkpoint-publication attachment to [R] Immutable content and revision lifecycle.

      |   `-- Correct the duplicated ownership overview around MappingEditorCanvas, MappingEditorRuntime, CanvasRuntime and MappingDocumentController. Preserve workspace, persistence and placement-choice attachments; connect runtime components to canonical detail rather than duplicating it.
      |-- [1b] Extend: [A] GridBox / LineGridScene
      |   `-- Add projection and settled-writeback boundaries without replacing the retained domain grid model.
      |-- [1b] Extend: [C] FloatingBox variants
      |   `-- Add native projection and settled geometry writeback through DisplayNodeBase; retain variant ownership and automatic placement rules.

      |   `-- Replace the obsolete per-call flow with settled controller commands, buffered exec, live editor undo and headless domain fallback. Connect AgentDiagrammingSessionService.exec to canonical buffering detail.
